description: This file defines the interface class DobbyInterface within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It declares methods for managing containers such as starting, stopping, pausing, resuming, and obtaining information about containers, as well as event handling functions related to container lifecycle. The class also maintains private members for proxy and IPC service interactions and event listening.

classes.name: DobbyInterface
classes.description: A class to interface with container management functionalities through Dobby, including launching, stopping, and monitoring container states, and handling related events.

methods.name: DobbyInterface
methods.description: Constructor for DobbyInterface class.

methods.name: ~DobbyInterface
methods.description: Destructor for DobbyInterface class.

methods.description: Initializes the interface with an event handler.

methods.description: Cleans up resources and terminates the interface.

methods.description: Lists all running containers.
